slice: Hostile-review the proposed current-state answers to Plaid's live security questionnaire. Return the safest truthful selection for every question and block any unsupported attestation. Review only; the live form remains untouched.
sharedContext: Live questionnaire has 11 questions plus a final remediation attestation: security contact; operationalized security policy; access controls; consumer MFA before Link; internal MFA; TLS 1.2+; Plaid-data encryption at rest; vulnerability management; privacy policy; consumer consent; enforced retention/deletion; final remediation checkbox.

Werkles is pre-launch. Stack: Next.js 15.3.2, React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Tailwind 3.4; intended Vercel; intended Supabase Auth/Postgres and planned Storage; Stripe Billing/Identity code/test paths; Plaid sandbox Link-token demo; Twilio foundation only; Checkr policy-blocked.

Known code truth: public-token exchange, encrypted Plaid Item/access-token custody, Assets/Balance evidence, webhooks, revoke, receipts, provider schema, and RLS are disabled/not connected. Intake server-session continuity is incomplete. No Storage bucket or reviewed retention/access policy is connected.

Thufir recovered prior draft answers but downgraded nearly every prior Yes: security contact supported; documented policy not operationalized; access-control selections unverified; consumer MFA not implemented; internal MFA unaudited; TLS likely but unproven; encryption-at-rest architecture-dependent; vulnerability practices unverified; privacy policy unconfirmed; consent not built end-to-end; retention/deletion not ratified or enforced.
The live form is open but unchanged. Save, attestation, Continue, and Submit are forbidden until Ben reviews the assimilated answer table.
liveStrings: By submitting, you attest to remediate any Plaid-identified gaps in your security practices.
Does your organization provide multi-factor authentication (MFA) for consumers ... before Plaid Link is surfaced?
Does your organization encrypt consumer data you receive from the Plaid API at-rest?
knownGaps: Exact dropdown option labels are not yet harvested; do not invent an option Plaid may not offer.
No runtime configuration, secrets, provider accounts, admin consoles, production environment, SSL scan, encryption statement, access audit, or policy ratification was inspected for this packet.
The questionnaire may allow explanatory or not-applicable options; final UI selection must match visible choices.

BEAN.vision: Prevent a pre-launch company from laundering planned architecture and provider defaults into present-tense security attestations.
BEAN.pull: Attack each current/proposed answer for unsupported Yes, misleading No, missing not-applicable logic, pass-through/data-minimization confusion, and representations that create legal or remediation obligations.
go: Return an ordered 1-11 table: safest truthful answer state, minimum explanation, required evidence, and BLOCK/SAVEABLE status.
Decide whether zero Plaid production data makes encryption-at-rest not applicable, No, or still requires an architecture explanation; do the same for consumer MFA before Link.
Attack the final remediation attestation and name exactly what Ben would be promising if checked.
BEAN.momentum: End with GO_TO_STAGE_FIELDS, PATCH_BEFORE_STAGE, or REJECT. Include the three most dangerous answers to get wrong.
BEAN.outOfLane: No form filling/saving/submission, provider calls, secrets, personal contact data, legal approval, invented controls, code, SQL, push, deploy, new chats, subagents, or secondary models.
